textwithimage.text:
Evaluation kit based on TQMa62xx(L)

The Embedded Starterkit STKa62xx serves as an evaluation kit based on the TQMa62xx and TQMa62xxL embedded modules. These modules are rooted in the Texas Instruments AM62xx processor family, offering a range of options, including Quad, Dual, or Single Cortex A53 configurations. The modules are known for their enhanced computing capabilities and scalable graphics performance, making them suitable for diverse applications.

This kit provides engineers with hands-on experience, allowing them to harness the power of these AM62xx modules effectively. It supports Gigabit Ethernet with Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) capability, making it versatile for a range of networking scenarios. The kit offers multiple interfaces, including LVDS, CSI camera support, and audio capabilities, ensuring it caters to various requirements.

Furthermore, the kit includes features like USB OTG, USB 2.0 ports, SD-card support, SIM card compatibility, and RS485, expanding its utility across different applications. Notably, it also supports CAN-FD, analog frontends, digital I/O, WiFi, Bluetooth, and mobile network connectivity.

One of the key advantages of the kit is its low power consumption, typically operating within the 1-2W range. Additionally, it incorporates integrated security functions, enhancing the overall security of the system.

In summary, the Embedded Starterkit STKa62xx offers FPGA engineers the opportunity to explore and evaluate the capabilities of the TQMa62xx and TQMa62xxL embedded modules powered by Texas Instruments' AM62xx processors in real-world scenarios, making it a valuable tool for developing and testing advanced computing and graphics applications.

text.text:
Features

  • Power-Efficient FPGA Architecture: Utilizes a power-efficient FPGA architecture to minimize energy consumption and heat generation.
  • High-Speed I/O Interfaces: Offers high-speed I/O interfaces, including PCIe, Ethernet, and USB, for seamless data transfer and connectivity.
  • Advanced DSP Capabilities: Provides advanced digital signal processing capabilities to handle complex algorithms and signal processing tasks.
  • Robust Design for Reliability: Designed with robust components and features for high reliability in demanding applications.
  • Scalability and Customization: Allows for scalability and customization, enabling engineers to tailor FPGA solutions to their specific needs

Starterkit STKa62xx(L) set
  • The core of the STKa62xx(L) set is the TQMa62xx and TQMa62xxL module with a Dual Cortex®-A53 / R5F CPU. The components contained in the starter kit constitute a modular system enabling you to develop your own product ideas. To develop your own hardware you can use the certified and qualified circuit components of the starter kit in your own designs.
